title: Chronomancer
text:
Chronomancer is an Ascendancy class for the Sorceress.


== Overview ==
The Chronomancer can manipulate time, gaining access to a variety of utility skills and other bonuses. She can refresh all cooldowns on command with Time Snap or stop all enemies in their tracks with Time Freeze. She can delay some damage taken with Phased Form and cast Temporal Rift to rewind her position and life, mana, and energy shield values back a few seconds while undoing any delayed damage, and Inevitable Agony applies a powerful damage amplification debuff that takes times to kick in. In addition, Quicksand Hourglass grants a fluctuating bonus to skill speed or area of effect, Now and Again grants a chance for her skills to repeat, and Apex of the Moment grants her a slowing aura.
